doorbell.count.answer.note: The user's answers waiting in the inbox, in a notice's counts. cards: " (HI-12)", or nothing.

doorbell.count.cardEvent.text: {n, plural, one {# card event} other {# card events}}{cards}
doorbell.count.cardEvent.note: Card events (a wake: a watched card changed) waiting in the inbox, in a notice's counts. cards: " (HI-12)", or nothing.

doorbell.count.handover.note: Handovers waiting in the inbox, in a notice's counts. cards: " (HI-12)", or nothing.

doorbell.count.message.note: Messages (from the user, an agent or Hive: a brief, a lane change) waiting in the inbox, in a notice's counts. cards: " (HI-12)", or nothing.

doorbell.count.notice.note: Hive's notices waiting in the inbox, in a notice's counts. cards: " (HI-12)", or nothing.

doorbell.count.task.note: Tasks waiting in the inbox, in a notice's counts. cards: " (HI-12, HI-14)", the cards they are about, or nothing.

doorbell.ids.more.note: Delivery ids in a notice past the first 20: the first 20 ("m1, m2"), then how many more.

doorbell.lanes.count.note: The unwatched lanes notice's count of lanes when no builder's name is left to show (an emoji's).

doorbell.lanes.namesMore.note: The lanes' builders past the first 10, in the unwatched lanes notice: the first 10 ("HB1, HB2"), then how many more.

doorbell.notice.checkpoint.text: {what}. Call hive_inbox now to read {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}{ack, select, yes {; act on {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} and ack {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}} other {}}, then carry on.
doorbell.notice.checkpoint.note: After the fixed "[Hive] New in your inbox: ", in a hook's reply after a tool call while the agent works. what: the counts by kind with their ids ("1 task (m12)"); n: how many; ack: yes when one needs acking (#903, #1530).

doorbell.notice.doorbell.text: {what}. Call hive_inbox to read {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}{ack, select, yes {, act on {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}, then ack {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}} other {}}.
doorbell.notice.doorbell.note: The doorbell, after the fixed "[Hive] New in your inbox: ": one line typed into an idle agent as its prompt. what: the counts by kind with their ids ("1 task (m12)"); n: how many; ack: yes when one needs acking (#903, #1530).

doorbell.notice.drain.text: Before you finish: your inbox has {what} you haven't read. Call hive_inbox{ack, select, yes {, act on {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} and ack {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}} other { and act on {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}}} before you end your turn.
doorbell.notice.drain.note: After "[Hive] ", as the agent's turn ends with its inbox unread (the Stop drain). what: the counts by kind with their ids; n: how many; ack: yes when one needs acking (#903, #1530).

doorbell.notice.lanesUnwatched.text: Lanes are running ({shown}) and nothing will wake you about them: watch the lanes (hive_wait_for_tasks with lanes ["all"], wake) before you finish.
doorbell.notice.lanesUnwatched.note: After "[Hive] ": the Assistant's notice as its turn ends with lanes running and no watch on them (HI-2069). shown: the builders' names ("HB1, HB2 and 3 more"), or how many lanes (lanesCount).
